_doc: Where each launchd job's code runs from (ASK-3966). Read by install-plist.sh and test-job-checkouts.py.
Founder, 2026-11-08: "ensure everyitng runs on separate work trees so things done conflict".
`pinned`: the jobs that run from their own worktree, <HOME>/<pinned_root>/<label>/<repo ident>, detached at
origin/main and created locked (worktree-reaper.py removes a clean idle worktree already on origin/main; a
locked one it keeps). kipi-job-pinned.sh advances it at the start of each run, and nothing else touches it.
OPT-IN, NOT OPT-OUT (PR #632 review, major 1): a label moves only when it is listed here and reinstalled
(install-plist.sh --pinned). Pinning every template by default changed 12 renders with no reinstall, and
fleet-health's plist-drift detector files one Linear issue per drifted label, daily.
`shared_exceptions`: every other committed template, each with its reason, the ticket that moves it and an
expiry at most 30 days after `since`. test-job-checkouts.py fails a template that is in neither list or in
both, and a pinned render that reaches outside its own tree with `/..` (PR #632 review, major 2).

com.kipi.lessons-daily.reason: Writes tracked files in the checkout (q-system/output/lessons-daily.out, q-system/memory/.sycophancy-monthly-stamp) and untracked logs that readers expect there.

com.kipi.openloops-heartbeat.reason: Writes tracked q-system/memory/open-loops.json and q-system/output/heartbeat-run-last.json in the checkout; sessions read them there.

com.kipi.weekly-improve.reason: Writes q-system/output/weekly-improve.log in the checkout and reads untracked inputs there.

com.kipi.voice-refresh.reason: Its stdout and stderr go to q-system/output/voice-refresh-nudge.out and .err in the checkout, and it reads q-system/output/voice-corpus/, which is untracked.

com.kipi.fleet-health.reason: Reads instance-registry.json; the shared checkout's copy is ahead of origin (infohawk, 2026-11-08), so a pinned copy would silently skip an instance.

com.kipi.lessons-drift.reason: Reads instance-registry.json, which is ahead of origin in the shared checkout (infohawk).

com.kipi.linear-triage-health.reason: Reads instance-registry.json, which is ahead of origin in the shared checkout (infohawk).

com.kipi.dispatch.reason: Already does its work from its own pinned checkout (kipi-dispatch-pinned.sh, ASK-812); only that wrapper is read from the shared checkout. It is the critical job, so it moves after kipi-job-pinned.sh has run one night on the others.

com.kipi.spillover-linear-check.reason: Names its sibling repos relative to the checkout (__KIPI_REPO__/../consulting, ../chief); pinned, those paths do not exist and the checker skips them and exits 0 (PR #632 review, major 2). Needs absolute sibling paths first.
